image_description: A black, heavy-duty ring binder standing upright against a white background. The binder features an orange spine and front cover label with the text 'Heavy Duty' and 'wilsonjones'. It has a clear plastic overlay pocket on the front displaying a graphic of the internal ring mechanism. The spine shows branding and capacity details (3 rings).

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of binder (view binder) and brand consistency.
To verify the legibility and correctness of the text 'Heavy Duty', 'wilsonjones', and spine details, as AI often fails here.
To check for melting or blurring at the sharp corners and the boundary between the plastic pocket and the cover.
To ensure the 3D perspective of the rectangular prism is physically valid and not warped.

focus_areas: Text legibility and spelling on spine and front cover
Sharpness of corners and edges (no melting)
Consistency of the plastic pocket reflection/transparency
Geometric straightness of the spine and cover alignment
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text rendering. AI generators frequently produce gibberish or warped letters on product packaging. Verify if 'wilsonjones' and 'Heavy Duty' are spelled correctly and if the font geometry is consistent. Also, check the transition between the black cover material and the orange label area for any bleeding or unnatural blending.
